name: cp-v7
idea_origin: Comprobante line, 29 Oct: token accounting of the real DeepSeek traces (history grows ~608 tokens per model call, 431 of them tool results and framing; total tokens are quadratic in the number of model calls) plus the pending candidates c5 (quality), t0 (Skill from level 4), suelo-v1-min (stalled start, size of the risk) and v4-lean-q (one observe per quarter; Leah's branch leah/workspace, not a registered parent)
hypothesis: Same tokens as cp-v5a (paired calls); the first promotion at month 6 as often as v4 (5 of 5 games of v3-v7) instead of 0 of 2.
predicted_behaviour: Replies with two or more tool calls; no visible text; notes of one line; tokens per month under 800k in an official game; same story choices as v4-c5 on the bank within repeat noise; Skill learning and Apply for rotation every quarter from level 4.
refutation: DeepSeek keeps one tool call per reply or writes analysis anyway (tokens per month above 1.1 M), or story choices move away from v4 more than a repeat of v4 does, or a missed first promotion or a trust crisis appears that v4 avoids.
change: cp-v5a without c5's 'Lay low and reduce risk for Health' main action in the near-a-limit line: with Health at 4 or below in the month-3 quarter (4 of 10 real games) it replaced Apply for a key project and cp-v3 reached the month-6 review with Skill 8 and Output 1. v4 kept the key project in the same situation.
